text:
maria_support: Hey @eng, raising an escalation — customer reported embeddings API returning 400 with 'Dimension mismatch' and we saw a sudden billing uptick for that account. They claim their client sometimes sends single vectors and sometimes batches in the same stream.

jonathan_eng: Can you paste the exact curl + payload they used and the full server response?

maria_support: Pasted below (redacted keys). Note the client mixes single-item calls and a batched array in the same integration.

maria_support: ```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \\\  -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" \\\  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\\  -d '{"model":"text-emb-1","input": [[0.12,0.03,0.11,...,0.05],[0.09,0.07,...,0.02,0.14]], "metadata": {"client_version":"1.2.3"}}'
```

maria_support: Server returned: ```json
HTTP/1.1 400 Bad Request
{ "error": "Dimension mismatch: expected 512 vectors, got lengths [512, 3] at index 1", "request_id": "req_8a7b3c" }
```

lina_support: Billing spike — do we have a breakdown for that request_id? Looks like some clients retried and doubled billed.

infra-bot: request_id=req_8a7b3c | route=/v1/embeddings | status=400 | processing_ms=42 | batch_size=2 | worker=embed-3a | account_id=acct_44b | tokens=0 | charge_units=2.0

sam_sre: Two quick things: 1) the payload shows a nested array of vectors (batched) but one of the inner elements is length 3 — likely user accidentally serialized a short summary vector somewhere. 2) We do have a gap where retries from the client hit two different frontends; our billing increments per accepted request even if returned 400 on worker — need to confirm why charge_units > 0 for a 400.

kevin_engineer: Repro script to validate shape locally: run the quick check to confirm mismatch before sending. I put this inlined for the customer: ```python
# quick sanity check
def validate_vectors(vs, expected_len=512):
    if isinstance(vs[0][0], list):
        arr = vs
    else:
        arr = [vs]
    for i,v in enumerate(arr):
        if len(v) != expected_len:
            print(f"BAD len at index {i}: {len(v)}")
            return False
    return True
```

maria_support: Customer ran that and saw index 1 flagged — they said their preprocessor sometimes compresses small docs into 3-d features for downstream similarity, and a bug combined both sources into one batch.

jonathan_eng: We should do two followups: 1) short-term: provide a recommended payload validator they can run client-side + snippet to coerce singleton vectors into [ [ ... ] ] when needed. 2) medium-term: server-side defensive validation that rejects mixed-dimension payloads earlier and returns 422 with no billing.

kevin_engineer: Agreed. Proposed server behavior: return 422 + "mixed_vector_lengths" and do not increment billable charge. I'll open a quick PR to change billing hook to run after schema validation.

sam_sre: For now, tell the customer to ensure Content-Type header present and to consistently use an array for batch even for single items. Example safe curl: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \\\  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \\\  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\\  -d '{"model":"text-emb-1","input": [[0.12,0.03,...,0.05]] }'
```

maria_support: I provided the validator, the safe curl, and asked for their integration logs (they uploaded the client side stack trace). They want the billing reversed for the two charged requests.

lina_support: I raised ticket BILL-2473 to refund charges for acct_44b for req_8a7b3c and the duplicate retry (ids: req_8a7b3c, req_8a7b3d). Finance said they'll wait for eng confirmation that charges were erroneous.

jonathan_eng: I'll mark the impl as high priority. For rollout: patch server to validate lengths before billing (hotfix on host pool 3), change response code to 422 and message to: "mixed_vector_lengths: all vectors must have same dimensionality". Also add metrics to track mixed-dimension errors.

infra-bot: deploy triggered: hotfix/validate-emb-lengths -> staging then canary -> prod. CI green.

kevin_engineer: Put a small telemetry tag on these 422 responses so support can auto-detect and avoid billing. Tag: error_code=mixed_dim_client.

maria_support: Customer confirmed they'll roll a client patch to always wrap singles as arrays. They requested confirmation when billing is refunded.

lina_support: Billing team flagged refund processed for acct_44b for the two reqs. Refund id REFUND-998.

maria_support: Closing loop with customer and sending final mitigation + validator. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

jonathan_eng: Follow-up issue created ENG-2041 to add server-side schema rejection and billing change.

sam_sre: Note: add unit test for batch_size accounting when validation fails.

kevin_engineer: I'll leave the canary running for 24h and watch metric mixed_dim_client.

infra-bot: canary metrics: mixed_dim_client=0 -> then 6 triggered during first 2h, alerted to oncall.

maria_support: Customer replied: "Thanks, we found bug in preprocessor and patched. No more errors after today's deploy"

kevin_engineer: Closing canary in 36h if stable.

maria_support: Thread resolved.
